Name: DMC5 Cavaliere Tractor
Author: VegetaBul
Description:
[center]该mod可将[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url][b] ﻿[/b]替换为DMC5 Cavaliere / Cavaliere R（首先，你需要有一台[b]拖拉机[/b]）

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39714/39714-1764241783-137095819.png[/img]﻿
（当然...并没有那么帅）﻿[/center]

[b]安装说明：[/b]

[list]
[*]将下载的文件解压，拖入 [i]Stardew Valley > Mods[/i]
[/list][list]
[*]进入游戏，在 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] > DMC5 Cavaliere 中选择将拖拉机替换为 Cavaliere / Cavaliere R﻿
[/list]

[b]Cavaliere音效替换说明（可选）：[/b]

[list]
[*]将Audio文件中的4条ogg文件拖入 [i]Stardew Valley > Mods > TractorMod > assets > audio[/i]，替换原文件（建议另行备份原音频以备恢复）
[/list][list]
[*]视频内有音效展示可做参考，所有音频均基于 DMC5 原音效并经过适配处理
[/list]
[b][i][url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1zJSMBLEyF/?vd_source=cd901cec0e60205d3a18279f1bb44855]示例视频[/url]﻿[/i][/b]
其实我并不是很满意音效的最终效果... 但这已经是我目前水平的极限了，此前我并未接触过音频编辑 T^T 希望你会喜欢

____________________
[center]
This mod replaces the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] with the DMC5 Cavaliere / Cavaliere R (First, you’ll need to own a tractor)

﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39714/39714-1764241784-1224154313.png[/img]﻿
﻿(Well, not as stylish as the real one)[/center]

[b]Installation:[/b]

[list]
[*]Extract the downloaded files
[/list][list]
[*]Drop the extracted folder into [i]Stardew Valley > Mods[/i]
[/list][list]
[*]Launch the game and go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] [i]> DMC5 Cavaliere[/i]
[/list][list]
[*]Select Cavaliere / Cavaliere R as the replacement for the tractor
[/list]
[b]Cavaliere SFX Replacement (Optional):[/b]

[list]
[*]Open the Audio folder included in the download
[/list][list]
[*]Drop 4 ogg files into [i]Stardew Valley > Mods > TractorMod > assets > audio[/i]
[/list][list]
[*]Replace the original files (it’s recommended to back up the original audio for restoration if needed)
[/list]
The showcase video includes sfx previews for reference. All sound effects are based on the original DMC5 sfx and have been adapted accordingly.
[b][i]
[/i][/b][url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1zJSMBLEyF/?vd_source=cd901cec0e60205d3a18279f1bb44855][b][i]Video[/i][/b][/url]

I’m honestly not completely satisfied with the final sound effect design… but this is the best I can achieve with my current skill, as I’ve never worked with audio editing before. T^T Hope you’ll like it.
